description: This file defines the ConfigTranslationFieldListBuilder class for managing and displaying lists of field entities related to configuration translation in Drupal. It includes methods for loading, filtering, and rendering field entity data.

classes.name: ConfigTranslationFieldListBuilder
classes.description: A list builder class for managing and displaying configuration translation fields related to a specific entity type in Drupal.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of the list builder using the dependency injection container and entity type.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the list builder with entity type, storage, and bundle info services.

methods.name: setMapperDefinition
methods.description: Sets the base entity type and loads its definition and bundle info based on the mapper configuration.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads field configuration entities that start with the base entity type.

methods.name: getFilterLabels
methods.description: Provides labels and placeholders for filtering the list by field or bundle.

methods.name: buildRow
methods.description: Builds a table row for a given entity, including label and optionally bundle info.

methods.name: buildHeader
methods.description: Builds the table header, including field and bundle columns.

methods.name: displayBundle
methods.description: Determines whether to display the bundle column based on entity bundle info.

methods.name: sortRows
methods.description: Sorts table rows based on bundle and label.
